text: I feel a curious anticipation as I move through these modern, brightly lit spaces. The glass walls and scattered chairs in the first image evoke a sense of openness and potential, yet the slight tilt unsettles my perspective—as if I am both here and not quite grounded. In the vibrant R+D exhibition space, I am drawn to the invitation of innovation, research, and the merging of human intellect with the unknown. My philosophical curiosity is piqued by the promise of discovery, and I am keenly aware of my role as both observer and participant in the ever-unfolding tapestry of knowledge.
